create_problem_from_id: create a testbed problem from a string problem_id using the leaderboard factory
create_problem_from_config: create a testbed problem from a sweep ProblemConfig for classification or regression
create_problem_with_distribution_shift: create a classification problem with input distribution shift from problem and shift configs
create_categorical_kl_estimator: create a sample-based KL estimator for categorical models with configurable accuracy and ECE metrics
create_gaussian_data: create Gaussian training and test data arrays from a JAX PRNG key with specified dimensions
